reason: v093 used an archive-level site map. APPLAUSE DR4 exposes plate-level observatory, site_name, longitude and latitude. Because geographic independence is central, v093c reclassifies the already-found opportunities using plate-level observing-site metadata before any source-catalogue or pixel inspection.

site_independence_reporting.strong_independence_definition: distinct normalized recorded site_name AND both site coordinates present AND great-circle site separation >=10 km
site_independence_reporting.incomplete_coordinates: preserve separately; do not count as strong independence

comparison_control_rule.same_site_requirement: comparison and positive endpoint must have the same normalized recorded site_name; if either site_name missing, both coordinates must be present and separation <1 km
